summary: Ocean ecosystems and marine life are impacted by various physical and biological factors. Ichthyoplankton dynamics, a crucial aspect of ocean health, are studied using this tool. The model simulates Lagrangian transport of particles, providing insights into ocean circulation and marine life distribution. This research contributes to understanding and managing ocean ecosystems, ultimately benefiting marine biodiversity and ecosystems. The tool's application is relevant to the conservation and sustainable use of marine resources.
